Author: Neeraj Tiwari
Bench: Neeraj Tiwari
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2025:Ahc:134897
Court No. - 1
Case :- Contempt Application (Civil) No. - 2871 of 2025
Applicant :- Mohammad Hashim

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Opposite Party :- Sri Jagveer Singh Chaudhary Food Safety Officer/ Prescribed Authority
Counsel for Applicant :- Aditya Prasad Mishra Hon'ble Neeraj Tiwari,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and Learned Standing Counsel for the opposite party.
Learned Standing Counsel for the opposite party has produced the order dated 5.5.2025 and copy of the same has also been given to learned counsel for the applicant.

On the basis of order, he submits that the order of the writ court dated 17.3.2025 rendered in Writ-C No. 1385 of 2025 has been complied with and the application has become infructuous, which is not objected by the learned counsel for the applicant.
Therefore, under such facts of the case, no further order is required to be passed.
Accordingly, file is consigned to record.
